comparability_notice: The Financial Development Index is a relative cross-country measure. Historical values can be revised when the IMF refreshes source data or index inputs; GIR therefore ties every published release to an immutable source snapshot.

gir_analytics.changes: computed only between observations in the same immutable release snapshot

method_notice: GIR imports the nine official IMF index series. It does not reconstruct the principal-component methodology from underlying financial-sector variables.
rank_notice: Ranks, percentiles and changes are GIR analytical fields calculated within one selected source snapshot. They are not separately published IMF series.
